program_name: SolCard Referral program (deposit-fee revenue share; partner codes on custom terms)
legal_entity: SC PAYMENTS LIMITED (Hong Kong, BRN 78350827) — operator named in the Terms of Use; the referral page is 'a description, not a contract'
application_conditions: Every SolCard account has a referral code and link in the dashboard — no separate application. 'Partners may run codes on custom terms agreed with SolCard' (partner codes do not earn milestone rewards). No publisher requirements, channel rules or acceptance criteria published.
paid_action: Commissionable top-ups by referred users: a share of the deposit fee the referee pays (not of the top-up amount), only on Solana or supported EVM networks.
validation_conditions: Commission comes only from deposit fees: top-ups with no deposit fee (Platinum, zero-fee promotions), Bitcoin/Litecoin/Tron top-ups and standard-code top-ups on 'Virtual for AI & Ad Spend' earn nothing; referrers or referees excluded for abuse earn nothing.

commission.model_note: Tiered share of the referee's deposit fee by all-time referred volume: Tier 1 5% up to Tier 6 40%. Separate one-off milestone rewards (free card issuance at $1,000 referred volume, up to $500 loaded to a card at $100,000; total up to $1,010), counting commissionable top-ups recorded from October 23, 2026.
commission.tiers_note: Six tiers from 5% to 40% of deposit fees; volume thresholds per tier not all stated on the page.

payout.method: USDT to a Solana wallet address entered by the referrer; each withdrawal confirmed with a one-time code
payout.frequency: On request once the $20 threshold is reached

rules_note: Commission is a share of fees charged to the referred user — the more a referee pays in top-up fees (Virtual tier 5%), the more the referrer earns; this incentive conflicts with recommending the cheaper Platinum tier and must be weighed before any use. The page is explicitly non-contractual; the Terms of Use govern. Card issuer not disclosed by the operator.
allowed_countries_note: Follows SolCard eligibility: not Hong Kong residents, not sanctioned persons; no positive country list.

evidence.title: SolCard — Referral program (last updated November 4, 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Commission is a share of the deposit fee the referee pays, 5% (Tier 1) to 40% (Tier 6); paid in USDT to a Solana address, withdrawal from $20; only Solana / supported EVM top-ups earn; milestone rewards up to $1,010 from October 23, 2026; 'Partners may run codes on custom terms agreed with SolCard'; 'a description, not a contract'.

notes: Identified only. Nobody contacted, no account opened. Fee-share model on a tier the comparator would not recommend for cost reasons — editorial-independence question for David before any application.
